product_options_evaluated.reason: Best addresses the post-round002 operator comprehension and artifact readiness gap while staying offline, local, deterministic, and inert.
More accounting depth is less useful than composing and validating the existing paper/accounting/dashboard/operator artifacts for manual review.
Server/frontend/runtime work changes the risk boundary before the local artifact contract is consolidated.
Telegram token/webhook/polling/command execution crosses a high-risk runtime boundary.
Read-only live refresh still introduces network/API/runtime behavior and is not needed for local review-pack composition.

recommended_round003_tasks.summary: Create a deterministic local JSON/Markdown operator review pack that composes existing paper audits, dashboard state, portfolio/accounting metrics, and operator inbox review outputs without decisions or recommendations.

Create a deterministic local artifact health/staleness report that checks existence, parse status, schema/version fields, expected fixture alignment, and stale embedded artifact pointers without live fetch or regeneration.
Define an inert static contract mapping manual command inbox command types to review-pack sections while preserving human-review-only and non-execution guarantees.
